title: 第3章 强大的肾之神藏，古碑签到地
content_zh:
转眼间，三年时间过去。
关于君逍遥的消息，依然在整个君家流传着。
所有人都知道了，君逍遥一出生，便惊动了十八祖，亲赐其神子身份。
至于零号序列身份，在君战天的刻意限制下，倒是没有流传出去。
因为君战天准备在君逍遥举办十岁宴时，广邀荒天仙域各大不朽势力，到时候再公布君逍遥零号序列的身份。
算是替君逍遥打响名声。
而且这样也能够给君逍遥安心成长十年的机会。
不过到时候，若是其余君家序列不满，也只能让君逍遥自己来解决了。
君逍遥对此倒是不介意。
他对自己的天赋还是有信心的。
十年时间足够了。
“逍遥，肉身境五大境界之后，便是神藏境五大境界，分别是心之神藏，肝之神藏，脾之神藏，肺之神藏，肾之神藏，分别对应金木水火土。”
“等到神藏五境大成后，便可聚灵海，凝神宫，化真灵。”
天帝宫一处殿宇内，君战天正在给君逍遥讲解修行。
这三年内，君逍遥一直都在巩固自身的境界。
每天各种圣药，神丹，像大白菜一般摆在君逍遥身前。
荒古圣体修炼，最耗费的就是资源。
但君家偏偏是荒古世家，还真承受得起君逍遥的资源消耗。
在三年积淀之后，君逍遥感觉，自己可以随时破入下一个境界。
“爷爷，那一般突破神藏五境需要多长时间？”君逍遥问道。

君战天沉吟道：“一般天骄，大约需要五年，绝世天骄，可能也需要两三年，你乃是荒古圣体，肉身无双，或许一两年时间就够了。”
“一两年吗？”君逍遥暗自思忖。
指明修炼道路后，君逍遥便开始沉下心来修炼。
他所修炼的，乃是君家的至尊功法，太玄经。
这门太玄经，足可一直修炼到至尊境界，乃是君家最为顶级的功法之一。
不过只要君逍遥想要，什么资源功法都能得到。
轰隆隆……
君逍遥体内，如有神雷在轰鸣，金色的气血充溢全身。
这三年的积淀，在此刻尽数爆发。
此刻若是内视，便可以看到，君逍遥体内，心脏熠熠生辉，仿佛将要开启一个门户。
“这……不会吧……”一旁的君战天都是有些发愣。
他才刚讲解完，自家孙子难道就要突破了？
小说也不敢这么写啊！
然而，就在君战天震惊之际。
君逍遥心脏内，仿佛有一扇门户被轰破了。
君逍遥只感觉，肉身增强了数倍，无尽金色气血滚滚汹涌，他的力量瞬间暴涨了十倍。
他感觉，没有君战天说的那么难啊？
既然顺利突破了，君逍遥也没有迟疑，继续开始冲击下一个神藏门户。
半个时辰后。
肝之神藏再度被轰破，气血震荡。

不过多时，脾之神藏，再度
然后是肺之神藏。
最后，在一天时间将要过去时，君逍遥通体一震，肾之神藏，终于轰开！
在体内五大神藏
而君战天老爷子，直接是呆愣在了原地，失神喃喃道。
“他娘的，当初老子突破神藏五境，也用了两年时间，这孙子竟然一天就突破了……”
人比人，气死人。
君战天感觉自己在孙儿面前，好像一个废物。
不对，就是一个废物。
除了年纪大点，修为高点之外，他哪里都比不过君逍遥。
“爷爷，我感觉有些不对劲。”君逍遥忽然皱眉道。
“怎么了，莫非是出什么问题了？”君战天回过神来，紧张道。
君逍遥可是君家的宝，若是出了什么问题，十八祖非得把他皮扒下来不可。
“我怎么感觉，肾之神藏的力量，要比其他四个神藏更加强大？”君逍遥疑惑道。
这并不是说他的其他四个神藏不强，而是肾之神藏，强的有些过分了。
君战天急忙上前查探，最后松了一口气，目光复杂中带着艳羡之意。
“爷爷，我没什么问题吧？”君逍遥问道。
“当然没事，逍遥啊，你以后可要为爷爷这一脉多多开枝散叶，等到十岁宴的时候，我托姜柔去把他们姜家的掌上明珠赐婚给你。”君战天说道。
“这……”君逍遥一愣，随即恍然大悟。
敢情荒古圣体还有这能力？

至于包办婚姻，君逍遥也不会随随便便喜欢上什么姜家的掌上明珠。
“对了，爷爷，你知道泰岳古碑是什么吗？”君逍遥转移话题道。
这三年来，君逍遥都在沉淀，并没有去签到。
现在他修为再度突破，是时候去签到地签到，领取奖励了。
“泰岳古碑原本是矗立在荒天仙域的一座石碑，用来检测肉身实力，不过后来被我们君家挖了回来，放在斗武场里，供后辈弟子检测肉身。”君战天说道。
“竟然是这样……”君逍遥微微汗然。
君家倒真是霸道，直接把泰岳古碑给挖回来了。
不过这样也好，省了君逍遥去寻找的功夫。
“爷爷，我想去泰岳古碑试一试。”君逍遥说道。
“这……”君战天迟疑。
去君家斗武场的年轻后辈，一般都在十岁以上。
君逍遥现在才不过三岁，即便是罕见的荒古圣体，但真要检测，说不定依然比不过那些年龄更大的天骄。
“爷爷，放心吧，我只是去试一试，失败了也没什么。”君逍遥道。
他只是想单纯去签到领个奖励而已。
“那好吧。”君战天微微点头。
孩子嘛，受点挫折也是好的。
省得天赋太高，养成那种妄尊自大的性格。
“到时候跟在孙子后面，失败了也好安慰安慰他……”君战天心里默默想到。
“三年了，终于可以走出天帝宫了！”
君逍遥走出天帝宫。

他虽只有三岁，但因为荒古圣体的原因，看上去已经像是个五六岁的男童了。
乌黑的发丝晶莹，根根生光，肌肤晶莹如玉石。
五官仿佛上天雕刻一般，俊秀天成。
小小年纪，就生得仙灵俊秀，仿佛一尊幼小的谪仙。
难以想象，长大之后，君逍遥将会何其丰神俊朗，秀逸绝尘。
“泰岳古碑签到，能获得什么奖励呢？”君逍遥心有好奇。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, three years passed.
News about Jun Xiaoyao is still circulating throughout the Jun family.
Everyone knew that as soon as Jun Xiaoyao was born, he alerted the Eighteenth Ancestor and granted him the status of the Son of God himself.
As for the serial number zero identity, it has not been spread due to Jun Zhantian's deliberate restrictions.
Because Jun Zhantian is planning to invite all the immortal forces in the Wild Heaven Immortal Domain when Jun Xiaoyao holds a tenth-year-old banquet, and then he will announce the identity of Jun Xiaoyao's serial number zero.
It can be regarded as building a reputation for Jun Xiaoyao.
And this can also give Jun Xiaoyao the opportunity to grow up in peace for ten years.
But when the time comes, if the rest of the Jun family is dissatisfied, Jun Xiaoyao can only solve it himself.
Jun Xiaoyao didn't mind this.
He still has confidence in his talent.
Ten years is enough time.
"Xiaoyao, after the five realms of the physical realm, there are the five realms of the divine treasure realm, which are the divine treasure trove of the heart, the divine treasure trove of the liver, the divine treasure trove of the spleen, the divine treasure trove of the lungs, and the divine treasure trove of the kidneys, which respectively correspond to metal, wood, water, fire, and earth."
"When the five realms of the Divine Treasure are completed, you can gather the sea of spirits, condense into the Divine Palace, and transform into a true spirit."
In a palace of the Emperor's Palace, Jun Zhantian was explaining cultivation to Jun Xiaoyao.
In the past three years, Jun Xiaoyao has been consolidating his own realm.
Every day, various holy medicines and magical elixirs are placed in front of Jun Xiaoyao like cabbage.
The most expensive thing to cultivate in the ancient holy body is resources.
But the Jun family is an ancient family and can really afford Jun Xiaoyao's consumption of resources.
After three years of accumulation, Jun Xiaoyao felt that he could break into the next level at any time.
"Grandpa, how long does it usually take to break through the five realms of Shen Zang?" Jun Xiaoyao asked.
Jun Zhantian muttered: "It will take about five years for an ordinary genius, and it may take two or three years for a peerless genius. You are an ancient holy body, and your body is unparalleled. Maybe one or two years is enough."
"One or two years?" Jun Xiaoyao thought to himself.
After pointing out the path of cultivation, Jun Xiaoyao began to concentrate on cultivation.
What he practiced was the Jun family's supreme technique, the Taixuan Jing.
This Taixuan Sutra can be practiced to the supreme realm, and it is one of the most top-notch techniques in the Jun family.
But as long as Jun Xiaoyao wants it, he can get whatever resources and techniques he wants.
Rumble…
Jun Xiaoyao's body felt like divine thunder roaring, and golden energy and blood filled his body.
The accumulation of these three years has all exploded at this moment.
If you look inside at this moment, you can see that Jun Xiaoyao's heart is shining brightly, as if a portal is about to open.
"This...can't be..." Jun Zhantian on the side was in a daze.
He has just finished explaining, is his grandson about to make a breakthrough?
I wouldn’t dare write a novel like this!
However, just when Jun Zhantian was shocked.
In Jun Xiaoyao's heart, it seemed as if a door had been blasted open.
Jun Xiaoyao felt that his physical body had strengthened several times, endless golden energy and blood surged, and his strength instantly increased tenfold.
He felt that it was not as difficult as Jun Zhantian said?
Since he successfully broke through, Jun Xiaoyao did not hesitate and continued to attack the next Shenzang portal.
Half an hour later.
The liver's divine treasure was once again blasted, and the energy and blood were shaken.
Not long after, the spirit of the spleen was hidden again.
Then there is the Lung God Store.
Finally, when the day was about to pass, Jun Xiaoyao's whole body was shaken, and the kidney's divine treasure was finally opened!
Five great treasures in the body
As for Mr. Jun Zhantian, he just froze on the spot and muttered absentmindedly.
"Damn it, it took me two years to break through the fifth realm of Shen Zang, but this grandson actually broke through in one day..."
Comparing people to each other makes people angry.
Jun Zhantian felt like a waste in front of his grandson.
No, it’s just a waste.
Except for being older and having higher cultivation level, he couldn't compare with Jun Xiaoyao in any way.
"Grandpa, I feel something is wrong." Jun Xiaoyao suddenly frowned.
"What's wrong, is there something wrong?"Jun Zhantian came back to his senses and said nervously.
Jun Xiaoyao is the treasure of the Jun family. If something goes wrong, the Eighteenth Patriarch will have to skin him off.
"Why do I feel that the power of the Kidney Divine Treasure is more powerful than the other four Divine Treasures? "Jun Xiaoyao said doubtfully.
This is not to say that his other four divine treasures are not strong, but the kidney divine treasure is a bit too strong.
Jun Zhantian hurriedly stepped forward to investigate, and finally breathed a sigh of relief, his eyes complicated with envy.
“Grandpa, there’s nothing wrong with me, right? "Jun Xiaoyao asked.
"Of course it's okay, Xiaoyao, you have to work harder for grandpa's lineage in the future. When the ten-year-old banquet is held, I will ask Jiang Rou to marry the daughter of the Jiang family to you. "Jun Zhantian said.
"This..." Jun Xiaoyao was stunned for a moment, then suddenly realized.
Daqing Ancient Holy Body still has this ability?
As for arranged marriages, Jun Xiaoyao would not just fall in love with the daughter of the Jiang family.
"By the way, Grandpa, do you know what the Taiyue Ancient Monument is? "Jun Xiaoyao changed the subject.
In the past three years, Jun Xiaoyao has been settling down and has not signed in.
Now that his cultivation level has broken through again, it's time to sign in at the sign-in place and receive the reward.
"The Taiyue Ancient Monument was originally a stone monument standing in the Wild Heaven Immortal Realm, used to test the physical strength, but it was later dug up by our Jun family and placed in the fighting field for future generations of disciples to test the physical strength. "Jun Zhantian said.
"It's actually like this..." Jun Xiaoyao sweated slightly.
The Jun family was so overbearing that they directly dug up the ancient monument of Mount Tai.
But this is good, as it saves Jun Xiaoyao the effort of searching.
"Grandpa, I want to try the Taiyue Ancient Monument. "Jun Xiaoyao said.
"This..." Jun Zhantian hesitated.
The young people who go to the Jun Family Fighting Arena are generally over ten years old.
Jun Xiaoyao is only three years old now. Even if he is a rare ancient holy body, if he really wants to test it, he may still be unable to compare with those older geniuses.
“Grandpa, don’t worry, I’m just going to give it a try, it’s okay if I fail. "Jun Xiaoyao said.
He just wanted to sign in and receive a reward.
"Okay then. "Jun Zhantian nodded slightly.
As a child, it’s good to suffer some setbacks.
Avoid having too much talent and developing an arrogant character.
"When the time comes, I will follow my grandson so that I can comfort him if he fails..." Jun Zhantian thought silently in his heart.
“It’s been three years, and I can finally leave the Heavenly Emperor’s Palace! "
Jun Xiaoyao walked out of the Emperor's Palace.
Although he is only three years old, he already looks like a five or six year old boy due to the Ancient Holy Body.
The jet-black hair is crystal clear and shiny at the roots, and the skin is as crystal clear as jade.
The facial features are as if they were carved by heaven, and they are handsome and natural.
At a young age, he was born as a fairy and handsome, like a young banished fairy.
It is unimaginable that when he grows up, Jun Xiaoyao will be so handsome, handsome and graceful.
“What rewards can you get by signing in to the Taiyue Ancient Monument? "Jun Xiaoyao was curious.
